						<a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Tarifs-Locations-Emplacements-CI-2026-prix-mini-maxi-A4.pdf" target="_blank">Rates</a>
</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="columns groupe-carte"><div class="columns__item"><p class="h3">Where we are</p><p>1737 Route de la Madrague, 83400 Giens</p></div><div class="columns__item map"><figure><a href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/RsjyVCxrkrcxt2m68" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><picture><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/carte-camping-int-420x420.webp" media="(max-width: 210px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/carte-camping-int-850x825.webp" media="(max-width: 420px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/carte-camping-int-768x745.webp" media="(max-width: 850px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/carte-camping-int-1024x994.webp" media="(max-width: 1024px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/carte-camping-int.webp" media="(min-width: 1025px)"><img decoding="async" src="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/carte-camping-int-420x420.webp" width="420" height="210" loading="lazy" alt="carte camping int" title="Lodgings 4"></picture></a></figure></div></div></div>		</header>
    <style></style>
	<main class="soussite">
		<h1>Vacation rentals to suit all your needs in the Var</h1><p><a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/en/international/welcome/">Camping International de Giens</a> offers a range of<strong> holiday accommodation options in Hyères</strong>, on the Giens peninsula, to suit a variety of holiday preferences. You’ll find <strong>mobile homes </strong>near the beach, <strong>comfortable and fully-equipped apartments</strong>, <strong>spacious and shaded pitches</strong>, as well as a villa available to rent so you can make the most of the Var coastline. </p><p>Our 4-star rating applies only to camping pitches and mobile homes. The apartments and the Villa are not included in this rating. </p><div class="group menu-ancres"><p>See the :</p><div class="buttons"><a href="#mobilhome" rel="noreferrer noopener" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Mobile homes</a><a href="#appartement" rel="noreferrer noopener" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Apartments</a><a href="#emplacement" rel="noreferrer noopener" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Locations</a><a href="#villas" rel="noreferrer noopener" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Villas</a></div></div><h2 id="mobilhome" class="inline">Mobile homes for rent <span class="fc-span">near the beach</span></h2><p>Camping International de Giens offers a range of mobile homes with varying levels of comfort. From standard mobile homes to air-conditioned models or those with a <a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/camping-avec-jacuzzi-privatif-var/">private jacuzzi</a>, there is something to suit everyone’s needs for a seaside holiday in Hyères. </p>
<ctv-availability data-product-id="140484;140963;90376;83226;139011;110894;104299;75365;17437;139014" data-background-color="#FFFFFF00"></ctv-availability>
<h2 id="appartement" class="inline"><span class="fc-span">Comfortable, fully-equipped</span> apartments</h2><p>The campground rounds out its range of accommodations in Hyères with several <a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/en/?post_type=blog&amp;p=13703">apartments</a>. Functional and comfortable, some of these accommodations also feature a hot tub to enhance your daily well-being. </p>
<ctv-availability data-product-id="28931;90410;75366;75367;17440;139009;90407" data-background-color="#FFFFFF00"></ctv-availability>
<h2 id="emplacement" class="inline"><span class="fc-span">Spacious, shady</span> pitches</h2><p>For fans of traditional camping, the campsites offer beautiful <a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/en/?post_type=blog&amp;p=13623">pitches</a>, shaded areas designed to combine comfort with freedom. </p>
<ctv-availability data-product-type="pitch" data-background-color="#FFFFFF00"></ctv-availability>
<h2 id="villas" class="inline"><strong><strong>Villa rental <span class="fc-span">on the Presqu&#8217;île de Giens</span></strong></strong></h2><p>The villa offers spacious accommodation with sea views, several bedrooms, a furnished terrace and all the facilities you need for a comfortable stay. The main room is air-conditioned. </p>
<ctv-availability data-product-id="110899" data-background-color="#FFFFFF00"></ctv-availability>
<p><em>The 4* rating applies to pitches and mobile homes only</em></p>
